chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salama ibn al-Khattab, from Abbad ibn Yaqub, from Ubayd ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
The milk of the black sheep is better than the milk of the red ones, and the milk of the red cow is better than the milk of the black ones.
ai.seo_question: What is the preferred color of sheep and cows for milk according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) outlines a comparative preference for dairy quality based on animal coloration, noting that black sheep milk surpasses red, while red cow milk exceeds black. This hadith from *Al-Kafi* reflects the practical agricultural wisdom of the time, linking physical characteristics to nutritional value, and is often cited in discussions of *fiqh* regarding permissible and preferred sustenance. It underscores the Shia tradition of integrating observable natural phenomena with religious guidance for daily living.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Abbad Bin Yaqoub, from Ubeyd Bin Muhammad, from Muhamad Bin Qays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Milk of the black sheep is better than milk of the red ones; and milk of the red cow is better than the milk of the black ones’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Salmah ibn al-Khattab from ‘Abbad ibn Ya’qub from ‘Ubayd ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Qays who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The milk of black sheep is better than that of the red ones; and the milk of red cows is better than that of the black ones.”’
